name: The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme
benefit:
- Research Assistant shall be paid ₹25,000/- per month (Rupees twenty-five thousand only) as honorarium, for their assignment.
- The assignment will be initially for a period of two years from the date of engagement.
- The assignment can be extended for a further period of not exceeding one more year, subject to the approval of the Secretary to Government (Law).
- Research Assistants are permitted
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a Postgraduate in Law (2 years programme) from the recognized Universities in the Indian Union. - The applicant must not be pursuing Postgraduate Degree in Law or any other Degrees or Programmes requiring their compulsory attendance elsewhere. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st January or 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 32 years as on 1st January, 2023, if applying under the one-time age relaxation granted by the Honorable Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry. ****The educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria may be relaxed in case of exceptionally outstanding and deserving candidates by the Government.***
